findings: Right-turn sequence shows head motion before chest/root turn; half-turn contains intermediate back/side poses, rather than one-frame whole-body reversal.
Feet visibly lift/replant during turns and locomotion. World-space planted corner stability is independently checked for all 900 simulation/render samples.
After 21 s stop input root decelerates over 0.1 s then remains still; final airborne foot settles.
Both fixed cameras show the whole actor for the complete final timeline, independently gated by projected world AABB for both actor versions.
limitations: No full-speed continuous viewing tool was available: inspection was frame-based temporal review of video-decoded contact sheets and paired source frames.
No human fear, naturalness or attention study; no perception claim.
No native gesture/audio/render timing/FPS or chapter AI route is exercised by this motion-only inspection stage.
